title: cyclosorus warmingii
intro: Cyclosorus warmingii, commonly known as the Warming's fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in South America, where it is valued for its various health benefits. The Warming's fern has been traditionally used to treat fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, with therapeutic actions attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
